questions.question_text: Amāre to Bhagwānno rājīpo thayā sāru ____________ janmojanm Bhagwānnā bhaktnī ja sevā karvī chhe.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut says, 'Amāre to Bhagwānno rājīpo thayā sāru janmojanm Bhagwānnā bhaktnī ja sevā karvī chhe.'

questions.question_text: Bhagwānnā santnī sevā to ____________ puṇyavāḷāne maḷe chhe paṇ thoḍā puṇyavāḷāne maḷtī nathī.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut says, 'Bhagwānnā santnī sevā to bahu ja moṭā puṇyavāḷāne maḷe chhe paṇ thoḍā puṇyavāḷāne maḷtī nathī.'

questions.question_text: Jene Parameshwar bhajvā hoy tene Bhagwānnī athavā Bhagwānnā bhaktnī ____________ maḷe tyāre potānu moṭu bhāgya mānīne sevā karvī.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut says, 'Jene Parameshwar bhajvā hoy tene Bhagwānnī athavā Bhagwānnā bhaktnī sevā-chākarī maḷe tyāre potānu moṭu bhāgya mānīne sevā karvī.'

questions.question_text: Jene Parameshwar bhajvā hoy tene Bhagwānnī athavā Bhagwānnā bhaktnī sevā-chākarī maḷe tyāre potānu moṭu bhāgya mānīne sevā karvī, te paṇ ____________ arthe ne potānā kalyāṇne arthe bhaktie karīne ja karvī, paṇ koī vakhāṇe te sāru na karvī.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut says, 'Jene Parameshwar bhajvā hoy tene Bhagwānnī athavā Bhagwānnā bhaktnī sevā-chākarī maḷe tyāre potānu moṭu bhāgya mānīne sevā karvī, te paṇ Bhagwānnī prasannatāne arthe ne potānā kalyāṇne arthe bhaktie karīne ja karvī, paṇ koī vakhāṇe te sāru na karvī.'

questions.question_text: Dāsī thaī raheje tu ____________, Nīchī ṭel maḷe to māne bhāgya jo...
questions.explanation: The kirtan says, 'Dāsī thaī raheje tu dīnadayāḷnī, Nīchī ṭel maḷe to māne bhāgya jo...'

questions.question_text: Dāsī thaī raheje tu dīnadayāḷnī, Nīchī ṭel maḷe to māne bhāgya jo; ____________ nishche maḷtī nathī, Purushottam pāse beṭhānī jāgya jo... sāmbhaḷ 2
questions.explanation: The kirtan says, 'Dāsī thaī raheje tu dīnadayāḷnī, Nīchī ṭel maḷe to māne bhāgya jo; Bhavabrahmādikne nishche maḷtī nathī, Purushottam pāse beṭhānī jāgya jo... sāmbhaḷ 2'
